why_two_candidates_and_not_a_guess.operand_reuse: the floor is 'one x read and one FMA per weight'. Every lane reads x from DEVICE memory and x is re-read once per row -- 17408 x 5120 = 89.1M reads, 356 MB of x traffic for a 47 MB weight matvec. x is 20,480 bytes and Metal allows 32,768 of threadgroup storage, so it FITS. This is the mechanism ACCELERATOR_REGISTER_BLOCKING already measured worth 2.48x for GEMM, and it is a KERNEL lever.
why_two_candidates_and_not_a_guess.instruction_latency: 307.7 G FMA/s is 2.9% of this chip's lane-issue rate, so the FMA is not throughput-bound -- but the inner loop chains every add through ONE accumulator, so it is a SERIAL DEPENDENCY where each add waits on the previous one's latency however much issue width is free.
